column1: # Traditional-Chinese term corrections for WH40K Battlesector.
# Applied AFTER OpenCC conversion (s2tw) during the text build. Use this to fix
# OpenCC phrase-conversion mistakes (e.g. s2twp turns 重装 -> 重灌 "reinstall")
# Format: one rule per line, <search><TAB><replace>. Lines starting with # and
# blank lines are ignored. Rules are applied top-to-bottom as plain-text
# replacements, so put longer / more specific terms before shorter ones.
